<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BankConfirmation" name="Bank payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping and billing address"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginRequest" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLoginConfirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLoginConfirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankConfirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingAddress" sourceRef="Task_SendAddresses" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddresses" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Start ordering"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to E-Shop" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginResult" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailed" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSelection" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_MoreProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerSplit" name="Perform payment and address steps in parallel" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressDifference" name="Shipping address differs from billing address?" default="Flow_AddressSame"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressMerge" name="Continue with addresses" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAddresses" name="Send addresses" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrder" name="Ordering steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="End_LoginFailed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSucceeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_CheckSelection" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_1" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_3" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Payment_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_1" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressDifference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressDifferent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressDifference" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddress != billingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressDifference" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_3" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_4" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressMerge" targetRef="Task_SendAddresses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Address_5" sourceRef="Task_SendAddresses" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin" targetRef="End_CustomerOrder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="E-Shop ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsResult" name="Credentials valid?" default="Flow_CredentialsInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send successful login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginFailure" name="Send unsuccessful login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShopSplit" name="Process order, payment and shipment preparation in parallel" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrderAfterSelection" name="Finish order after product selection"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentData" name="Receive payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" name="Receive bank payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddresses" name="Receive shipping and billing address" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShopJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order after payment and address"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_1" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsValid" name="Valid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsResult" targetRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsInvalid" name="Invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsResult" targetRef="Task_SendLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_3" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_4" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ShopSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Order_1" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSplit" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderAfterSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Order_2" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderAfterSelection" targetRef="Gateway_ShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Payment_1" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Payment_2" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Payment_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Payment_4" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Payment_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Payment_6" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_ShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Shipment_1" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Shipment_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddresses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_Shipment_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddresses" targetRef="Gateway_ShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_6" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_7" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
